CustomField.description: FSD 5.10.5 usage variance: the change in consumption valued at the PRIOR unit rate. It isolates how much of the dollar change was caused by using more or less, holding price constant. Blank until a prior bill exists.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much of the change versus last month came from using more or less, priced at last month rate. A positive number means more was consumed. Blank on a first bill or where last month consumption was zero.
CustomField.label: Usage Variance
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Prior_Utility_Bill__c), Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Consumption__c = 0 ), null, ( Consumption__c - Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Consumption__c ) * ( Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Total_Charges_Amount__c / Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Consumption__c ) )
